summary.default: Translates mail and selected text, with nothing to set up. The text goes to a third-party translation service through an unofficial interface, which may be rate limited or stop working.
summary.zh-Hans: 翻译邮件与选中文本，无需设置。文本会通过非官方接口发送到第三方翻译服务，可能被限流或失效。

summary.default: Local judge models: label mail and answer yes/no questions on this computer, with no mail sent anywhere. Downloads a 2–2.7 GB model when you choose it; on computers without Apple silicon it is slow and best for new mail only.
summary.zh-Hans: 本地判断模型：在本机给邮件打标签、回答是非题，邮件内容不发往任何地方。选用时下载 2–2.7 GB 的模型；非 Apple 芯片的电脑上较慢，建议只给新邮件打标签。
